bio.text: Maryam Khan was elected in a March 2022 special election to represent the 5th House District, serving Hartford and Windsor.
Khan was re-elected in November 2022 to a term in a district that now also includes South Windsor.

According to the page, Khan is the first Muslim member of the Connecticut House, and in 2023 was appointed chairperson of the Building Educational Responsibility with Greater Improvement Networks Commission.
